I am an Assistant Professor in Finance at the Xavier Labour Relations Institute's (XLRI) Delhi-NCR Campus. My research interests include **asset pricing**, **AI/ML in investment strategies**, and **climate risk**.

::: {.callout-note icon=false}
## Prof. M. J. Manohar Rao Young Economist Award — 2024
Awarded by The Indian Econometric Society (TIES).
:::

## Education

- **PhD in Finance and Accounting** — Indian Institute of Management Lucknow
- **Masters in Finance and Control** — Department of Financial Studies, University of Delhi
- **BA (Hons) in Business Economics** — Shivaji College, University of Delhi
